page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.g8ae family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T34 processors operating at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.g8ae.32xlarge offers a high-density compute and memory configuration suitable for enterprise-scale workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, distributed caching, and general-purpose data processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at 3.4 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Given its high core count and dedicated resource allocation, this instance is designed for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, and distributed data processing workloads requiring consistent compute performance and high network throughput.
